description: Check that the server is running and see which data sources this process will use. Reports the server name and version, each source's adapter id and whether it is enabled, and whether its API key is configured (never the key itself). Needs no credentials and no network — use it to verify connectivity before searching.

message.description: Optional message to echo back in the text response. Omit for a plain 'pong'.

name: drugdata_ping

referenceSources.description: Key situation for the NLM reference sources.

pubmedConfigured.description: Whether any NLM_PUBMED_* variable is set (optional etiquette/rate-limit identification). Never reveals the values.

umlsConfigured.description: Whether UMLS_API_KEY is set; UMLS reference searches error with configuration advice when it is not. Never reveals the key.

sources.description: Every source, in the server's fixed order.

configured.description: Whether this source's API key is present; always true for sources that take no key. Never reveals a key.

enabled.description: Whether this source participates in searches — false when listed in DRUGDATA_DISABLED_SOURCES.

id.description: Adapter id, as accepted by DRUGDATA_DISABLED_SOURCES.

title: Ping the server
